The “Essential” range products are equipped with all common features covering a wide range of video solutions for various applications. The “Professional” product range was designed for complex demands. With additional functions, these products offer significant advantages for more specific tasks. The "Premium" product range contains products whose functional scope is fully adapted to high-end applications. CAMERA The GRUNDIG Security camera portfolio is designed for a wide range of surveillance tasks. It includes both IP and HD-TVI cameras with resolutions from 2 MP up to 12 MP in various designs and with a wide range of features. Grundig camera RECORDER GRUNDIG Security offers a wide product range of recorders: from simple embedded IP systems to analogue multinorm IP recorders to Windows-based recorders with the fully functional GRUNDIG Video Management System (VMS) powered by C-WERK®. All common standards are supported, including IP, TVI, CVI, AHD and CVBS. Grundig recorder MONITOR The GRUNDIG Security monitor portfolio includes monitors from 25.6 cm (10.1 inches) up to 140 cm (55 inches). This range meets all requirements - from compact monitors for standalone workstations to a freely configurable video wall. Be surprised by the clear and detailed display of the GRUNDIG Security TFT LED monitors! Grundig monitor SOFTWARE The GRUNDIG Video Management System powered by C-WERK® is fully scalable and features easy-to-use interfaces. Regardless of the requirements, all use cases can be easily covered with this software solution. If you remain true to yourself Whether it concerns security or everyday business processes in retail, industry or museums: the challenges we face change every day. The change in security-relevant influences is of course particularly critical. Thanks to the diverse selection of hardware and software from GRUNDIG Security and the many years of experience of our support team, we can develop customized solutions for you. The sensible use of Grundig image analysis with the unique forensic search system easily optimizes your processes for you. Grundig offers complete solutions based on the latest IP and high-resolution TVI technology - both as a first installation and for the expansion of an existing system.
